name: Gateway Cable Company
old_description: Gateway Cable is one of the nation's leading manufacturers specializing in military power distribution.
about:
Gateway Cable Company was founded in 1979 by Dennis Flerlage in Bensenville, Illinois, before relocating to its current headquarters in Lisle, Illinois. The company is wholly owned and operated in the United States, with a Midwest location chosen for efficient shipping to both coasts and international access via Chicago's O'Hare International Airport, 45 minutes away.

The company manufactures electrical connectors, cable assemblies, and power distribution components for military and commercial applications. Its product line includes NATO intervehicle connectors, receptacles, adaptors, military hardware, receptacle assemblies, power cable assemblies, and in-line fuse assemblies for battery and starter cables. Gateway Cable provides prototyping, engineering, and manufacturing services from an ISO 9001:2015 and CMMC certified facility, and also performs aluminum casting for caps and bodies.

Primary customers include the U.S. military—with procurement approval from the Army Tank-Automotive Command—and allied defense interoperability systems. The company also serves aerospace, industrial, agriculture, construction, and transportation sectors, supplying components for commercial use in those industries.

Gateway Cable emphasizes that all component materials are traceable to U.S. origins and DFAR compliant, and it highlights its commitment to complying with customer demands while providing high-quality products. The company also supports the Wounded Warrior Project and the USO.
